**Describe the bug**
A clear and concise description of what the bug is.

**Provide a Reproducible example**
a minimal reproducible example (see [reprex](https://reprex.tidyverse.org/) and [further reading on Stack Overflow](https://stackoverflow.com/questions/5963269/how-to-make-a-great-r-reproducible-example/16532098)) will be very helpful.
Consider using the small built-in `plyxp::se_simple` for these examples if possible. 

**Expected behavior**
A clear and concise description of what you expected to happen.

**Additional context**
Add any other context about the problem here.
